awards.title: 2026 UCLA Emerging Genomic Scientist
awards.summary: This highly successful event showcases innovative genomics research by senior predoctoral and junior postdoctoral scientists who are selected from around the country. In addition to presenting their research at the symposium, the speakers have the opportunity to form short or long-term mentorship and collaboration relationships with UCLA researchers.
